headline: Shivani Gupta files SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) disclosure in PC Jeweller Limited
sum: Shivani Gupta filed a substantial acquisition of shares disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a threshold crossing in her shareholding or that of a group acting in concert in PC Jeweller Limited. The exact shareholding percentage, consideration amount, and whether a mandatory open offer is triggered cannot be confirmed from the disclosure headline alone.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures track threshold events (5%, 10%, 25%, etc.) in listed company shareholdings; this filing may signal a structural event such as a promoter regrouping, share pledge release, or transfer between promoter family members—common mechanics in family-controlled listed entities to reorganise group holdings or settle historical SEBI enforcement actions.
detail: Shivani Gupta, who was subject to a 2021 SEBI insider trading penalty order (Rs 20 lakh fine and two-year trading ban on PC Jeweller securities), has filed the Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011 with NSE. Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of encumbered shareholdings by promoters and promoter groups on an annual or event-driven basis. The exact event triggering this disclosure—whether a threshold crossing, pledge release, inter-se transfer, or annual affirmation—and the shareholding percentage or value is not stated in the available headline.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandates disclosure of shares held, pledged or encumbered by promoters and promoter groups; triggers at 5%, 10%, 25%, 33%, 50%, 75% thresholds or on material changes.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015 (LODR), Regulation 30
framework.note: Requires timely disclosure of material events and changes in shareholding to stock exchanges; foundational for listing compliance.

framework.ref: SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations 2015, Regulation 4
framework.note: Defines connected persons and insiders; Shivani Gupta remains subject to prior enforcement sanction (restraint on dealing in PC Jeweller shares until 2023).

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 10
framework.note: Triggers mandatory open offer requirement when acquiring >25% or >5% within prior 12 months; applies if threshold breached.

framework.note: Exchange listing agreement mandates continuous disclosure obligations on material events.
Shivani Gupta was subject to prior SEBI insider trading enforcement order; settlement framework may be relevant if this filing relates to enforcement closure or settlement compliance.
